description: This file defines the backend logic for the user registration page in an ASP.NET Core web application, including user creation, email confirmation, and login handling.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: PageModel for user registration, handling GET and POST requests.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object holding user registration input fields.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the registration page, optionally setting the return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles form submission for user registration, performs user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in.
